notes.title: Update v1.3.0-beta: Balancing, new music and more!
notes.content:
[b]Balancing[/b]
- Reduced all shop prices on page 1 by a small amount as well as endless progression prices by a high amount. You can refund your gold to profit on those smaller prices if you bought them already (you get all your gold that you invested back regardless of current prices, and you can reinvest with lower prices afterwards).
- Decreased Cooldown of Fire Drop + Fire Meteors (two spells that felt underwhelming)
- Made some crow swarms more manageable that felt unfair before (less hp and larger gaps between swarms).
- Reduced hp of enemies slightly that spawn in a ring around the player ("trap"): 
I originally didn't intend to people to try to actually break through the ring (at least without having enough meta upgrades), but after seeing that many try to break through anyways, fail and get frustrated, 
i try to make that an option too (although not an easy option).
- Circle in the "Stay in the Circle" Mode now expands over time (and shrinks back over time) before/after bosses (instead of adjusting instantly). 
- Stepping outside the circle now does more damage to the player and scales with the player's max hp.
- Reduced overall difficulty of caverns: Enemies have less hp. Buffed amount of xp crystal drops from rats and slimes slightly. Rats drop more food.
- Decreased enemy strength in Speed Up Mode from +200% to +150%
- Enabling modes might make the game significantly harder, especially at the beginning. That might not be obvious for new players, that's why i made them unlock only after finishing the first map now.

[b]Music[/b]
- Added a new title song for the main menu.
- Forest now has a new song.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Fixed a missing word in an achievement description.
- Rounded gold in death screen.

[b]Other[/b]
- The game became now officially "playable" (instead of "unsupported") on steam deck since the last update.
- Updated the demo to the latest version.

notes.title: Update v1.2.2-beta: Improved Controller Navigation
notes.content: Pressing B on Xbox Controller/Steam Deck now goes back in menus and (un)pauses the game.

notes.title: Update v1.2.1-beta: Balancing, Quality of Life and more!
notes.content:
[b]Balancing[/b]
- Slightly raised speed and damage of some necromancer minions
- Reduced difficulty of Caverns

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
- Arrow to events are further away from the screen edge now so they don't overlap with the ui
- Included option to hide cats
- Cats now teleport to the player if they are too far away

[b]Other[/b]
- Updated demo to latest version

notes.title: Update v1.2.0-beta: New Map, Performance optimizations and more!
notes.content:
Happy new year, everyone!

[b]New Map[/b]
The 7th map is out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/7cee17eb8dfadc55a3fb44da84342fe7ac1bb409.jpg[/img]

[b]Performance[/b]
After analyzing the performance metrics of the game i noticed that up to 60% of the game's performance is used for drawing damage numbers.
I optimized the code that goes into drawing those, resulting in a significant fps increase. Even after this it's still the most performance hungry thing in this game, so if you still experience performance issues you can disable those numbers in the options.
Further performance optimizations:
- Reduced pixel size of images that were too unnecessarily detailed compared to others. 
Got rid of mini lag spikes that happened when images were loaded in with this change.
- Reworked code for shadows (slightly more fps)
- Reworked code for collecting crystals and gold (slightly more fps)

[b]Balancing[/b]
Summoned minions felt too weak and slow compared to regular spells, especially at later levels => Made most minions faster. Every mage that summons them got buffed that way, especially the necro mage.

[b]Two new steam achievements[/b]
One for completing the map Trapped, another one for the new map Forest. The game is capped by steam to a maximum of 100 steam achievements at the moment ("profile features limited/steam is learning about this game"), so i can't implement more for new maps. If the game manages to unlock the full profile features some day i plan to implement many more (and more content around those). The cap is lifted once the game gets high enough sales numbers and "player engagement" (not specified what that entails, probably reviews and such).

[b]Bugfix[/b]
- Fixed issues for displays that have an aspect ratio of 16:10

notes.title: Update v1.1.0-beta: Additional Customization, Quality of Life and more!
notes.content:
[b]Customization Menu for Hallucinations[/b]
Due to popular demand i decided to provide an option to choose the displayed filters in the "hallucinations mode". You can navigate to it at the screen where you choose the modes.
The customization screen is unlocked after getting 2 "hallucinations mode" achievements. 
If you don't want to play that mode for that you can also just look for hidden mushrooms in the levels to unlock those achievements.

[b]Quality of Life/UI changes[/b]
- Implemented an option to skip future lvlups (after everything is maxed out) for a 200 gold reward per lvlup
- Dedicated one ability slot as a seperate relic slot
- Selected item in the menu has a yellow marker now to make controller/keyboard navigation easier
- improved button "hitbox" in the menu to make mouse navigation easier
- Passive items don't show a 0 damage number anymore when hovering over them

[b]Balancing[/b]
- increased firing rate of cursed imp
- increased desert map difficulty past minute 50
- increased cooldown of ice axe

[b]Other[/b]
- Fixed a crash that can occur in the main menu
- Updated the demo to the latest version of the game (but limited to one hero and two maps)

notes.title: Update v1.0.3-beta: Bugfixes and more!
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Reworked weapon collision to prevent continous weapon damage by the same weapon
- Pot of gold upgrades now reset properly after refund (spent gold was already refunded properly. That means if you refunded before this update and refund again now you might get less gold back than the upgrades are worth because your gold was already refunded)
- Implemented a failsafe in case the circle (circle mode) leaves the map in cavern

[b]Other:[/b]
- Difficulty and mode selections are now saved after closing the game
- Minions that the Cavern boss spawns have more hp now
- Ultimate mage gets 20 lvlup rerolls in total

notes.title: Update v1.0.2-beta: Performance, Balancing and more!
notes.content:
[b]Performance[/b]
- Reworked weapon collision code for slightly more performance.
- Reworked desert for more performance after minute 20.
- Added option to hide damage numbers.

[b]Balancing[/b]
- Made enemies in hardcore difficulty (4 skulls) slower in grasslands, crypts, badlands, desert.
- Imp relic now costs only 25hp instead of 35hp.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Ingame achievements for the ultimate mage had wrong titles.
- One tile didn't have a texture in Cavern map.
- Fixed gold getting stuck below feet of the character.
- Ring of Regeneration + Holy Grail is now available for all characters.
- Fixed scaling of bats at the cavern boss.

[b]Other[/b]

- Cavern boss now moves slowly and spawns little versions of himself.

notes.title: Update v.1.0.1-beta: Balancing and Bugfixes
notes.content:
[b]Balancing[/b]
- Decreased difficulty of Hardcore Mode in Desert and Cavern.
- Increased amount of gold you get from treasure rats in Cavern.
- Increased damage of all necromancer summons by 10%.
- Increased cooldown of following attacks by 5%:
Phoenix
Tactical Nuke
Nuclear Bomb

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Armor calculation was off, fixed that. Decreased the amount of armor that upgrades provide and buffed the damage of enemies in return.
- Upgrading a weapon doesn't reset its cooldown now.

notes.title: Update v.1.0.0-beta: New Map!
notes.content:
[b]New Map[/b]
The 6th map so far is out! Try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/6f5eecbf87706e71df7ccf469a6715c9d2c738ee.jpg[/img] (The suggested minimum requirements are having most of the shop (page 1 and 2) and most mage upgrades unlocked)

notes.title: v0.9.0-beta update: Customize your run even further!
notes.content:
Mode Menu:
- You can select different modes at the same time now in the new mode menu! Mix and match the modes you like!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/798a63de6827e0dd2d08bc621dbb9362d8d9b8cf.jpg[/img]

Hardcore Difficulty:

Bugfixes:
- Pause screen/Death screen layout was a bit off, fixed that now
- Rounded display of gold/xp in Pause/Death Screen

Balancing:

- Player minions have a higher minimum speed in Speed Up Mode
- Loot travels faster to the player in Speed Up Mode
- Hallucinations mode gives +20% gold boost modifier
- Reduced Damage of Ice Axe, Water Hurricane and Spikes
- Increased Endgame Shop Prices

notes.title: v.0.8.7-beta update: Attack adjustments, Balancing and more!
notes.content:
[b]Attack adjustments[/b]
Changed the behaviour of following attacks to make them differentiate more from similar attacks:
- Fire Flower
- Snowflake
- Triangle of Darkness
- Water Geyser
- Water Hurricane
- Fire Explosion
- Each Axe attack from all characters except the fire mage

Changed the spawning mode of following attacks from random on the map to spawning at a random enemy and decreased their damage in return:
- Fire Hand
- Magma Geyser
- Spiral of Doom

Also changed the possible spawning radius of several other attacks to make them appear nearer to the player.

[b]Knockback Balancing[/b]
- Reduced amount of knockback by implementing a small time window after a push where the enemy can't get pushed further. 
- Reworked knockback to reduce the chance your own weapons push the enemy into you:  Most attacks now either push the enemy away from you or you have time to react before the attack can push the enemy into you (attacks spawn further away or need some time to activate).

[b]Other Balancing and Tweaks[/b]
- Napalm duration increased considerably (slightly decreased damage in return)
- Reduced tactical nuke damage.
- Skeleton Soldier Size - 30%
- Reduced hp of ghost wolves (non-pushable) considerably
- Changed Shorter Run Bonus Modifier from +15% Cooldown Reduction to +25% Attack Power.
- Adjusted the volume of sound effects of some attacks.
- Adjusted the art of some attacks to make them more consistent to each other.
- Base hero speed +5%
- Base enemy speed +2-4%
- Necromancer minions have another coloured outline now (dark red)

notes.title: v.0.8.6-beta update: Weapon opacity, Mode balancing and more!
notes.content:
[b]Weapon opacity option[/b]
With enough upgrades, the screen can fill up completely with your attacks, that's why i added an option to decrease the Weapon opacity in the option menu now!

[b]Mode balancing[/b]
Decreased Cooldown Reduction Bonus of Shorter Run Mode from 20% to 15% and Speed up Mode from 40% to 25%.

[b]Hallucination Mode achievements[/b]
The hallucination mode is not for everyone and you shouldn't be forced to play it to get all the achievements. That's why you can earn hallucination mode achievements now in an alternative way: There is a mushroom hidden in each stage, finding it and picking it up will grant these achievements too (there is a mild temporary screen effect when picking it up).

This patch was motivated by Kersakofs (Lean Demon) suggestions, thanks for it!

notes.title: v.0.8.5-beta update: New relics and more!
notes.content:
[b]New Relics[/b]
- 5 new Relics (e.g. a relic that summons an imp).

[b]New Swarm Patterns[/b]
- Swarms now fly in different patterns (implemented in grasslands and badlands)

[b]Balancing[/b]
- Balanced old relics
- Increased kills needed for the blood altar from 40 to 80
- Decreased food drops
- Balanced luck stat
- Balanced gold/xp/enemy strength in all stages

notes.title: v0.8.4-beta update: New map, weapon damage summary screen and more!
notes.content:
[b]New Map: Cavern[/b]
5th finished Map in this game, more are planned!
This map unlocks by getting 40 achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/926e88029deee939ae3b39a9a812bb90e3077317.png[/img]


[b]Weapon Damage Summary[/b]
Can be found in the pause/gameover menu:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/ea005daa5bee21a8ac7681fa89fd955cd2733751.png[/img]


[b]More[/b]
- Badlands Mage Bosses and their projectiles are easier to see now.
- Badlands difficulty didn't scale with the selected difficulty, fixed that now.
- Increased shop and upgrade prices.
- Crypts Stage now shows distance to boss.

notes.title: v0.8.3-beta update: Difficulty adjustments and more
notes.content:
[b]Difficulty[/b]
The updates since releasing the first version to beta testers and the public demo made the game easier than i liked to: i had buffed certain weak attacks, made more meta upgrades available, nerfed traps and wolves, etc.
The game is a bit too easy now for my taste, this is the first of many upgrades to make the game harder again: 
- Increased the difficulty of grasslands, badlands and desert. 
- Increased shop prices (later upgrades) because the meta progression was too fast once you got enough gold/xp boost modifiers.
- Aside from implementing a few more dangerous situations for each already existing stage, i plan to develop a new difficulty (hardcore mode) as well as new harder stages (cavern as first one) in the next updates.

 [b]Other[/b]
- Added a title to the main menu image so you actually know which game you are playing
- Increased the size of the spells "Fireburn" and "Dark Hands" to make them more visible
- Added the vacuum item (that pulls everything to you) to non_marked (no pointer, randomly found on the map) chests in grasslands and badlands so they have a real purpose to exist

notes.title: v0.8.2 beta update: Treasure Rats, Cursed Relics and more!
notes.content:
[b]Treasure Rats[/b]
Hunt those rats for their treasure! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/ae47f95a65aa3786365e6f642c51507e0e64c63f.gif[/img]

[b]Cursed Relics[/b]
Get Cursed Relics at the blood altar! They provide great boons, but also debuffs. 6 cursed relics are implemented at first, but more are planned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/93adbe0a39e74610939690bc9ab3bd9aa1d298e2.jpg[/img]


[b]Other[/b]
- Redesigned pointers (to bosses, treasure etc.) to make them easier to see
- Bosses now spawn near the player instead of randomly on the map
- Cooldown Reduction Calculation was off (too low especially at higher numbers), now it should calculate correctly. 
- Capped Cooldown Reduction at 99%.
- Traps have a higher radius now, so it is much easier to stay in them. Increased the damage of the traps in return if you try to flee out of them.
- Added a circle outline overlay in the "Stay in the Circle Mode" that makes the circle outline always visible even if the screen is filled with stuff.
- Weapon attacks now don't despawn instantly when leaving the screen but stay a while now, that makes it possible to hit enemies offscreen too
- New "Wave Spawning": Instead of spawning only a few enemies every tick, sometimes enemies spawn in bigger numbers at once (to be expanded in later patches)
- Balancing (lots of smaller balancing adjustments, especially in gold/xp rates)

notes.title: v.0.8.1 Hotfix for new character
notes.content: The achievement ("Ultimate Mastery") didn't unlock and the new mage was missing some dark magic spells, thanks to Scintilus for testing it!

notes.title: v.0.8.0 beta update: New hero, achievements and more!
notes.content:
[b]New Hero[/b]

The character from the title picture is now implemented! You can unlock him by getting 70 achievements.
He combines the attacks from the previous heroes, instead of having to focus on one element he can use all of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/b720136664997d96118153cec9bb48e943cc3d4a.gif[/img]


[b]New Achievements[/b]
I designed a total of 96 achievements now. Steam limits me to a maximum to 100 achievements until i reach an unknown sales quota. When steam allows me to design more achievements i plan to implement many more!

[b]Enemy art work adjustments[/b]
I made some enemy artwork more consistent with the rest.

[b]Enemy spawning[/b]
Enemy spawnrate (normal enemys, not special enemies) will slow down if you barely kill any of them to prevent a huge pileup outside of the screen. To counterbalance that, if you move too far away from enemies they will teleport nearer to you (outside of the screen).

notes.title: v0.7.8-beta/demo update: Hotfix for crash
notes.content:
[b]Hotfix[/b]
In the last update i implemented many new achievements, one of them (getting over 20k gold in a single run) caused a crash, that is fixed now. Thanks to Scintilus for pointing it out!

notes.title: v0.7.7-beta/demo update: Over 20 new achievements, resolution fixes and shadows
notes.content:
[b]Over 20 new achievements[/b]
I filled a whole page of the achievement unlock system! There will be much more achievements coming, that's why i started a second page now (there's a button at the bottom):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/93a50c2c267cca066aa24c00ee5c6c5cbad14a69.jpg[/img]
The rewards for unlocking achievements are also slightly better now, but require more achievements to unlock (10 instead of 8 per reward).

[b]Resolution fixes[/b]
Displays that had a different aspect ratio than 16:9 had some resolution issues with the game, that should be fixed now.

[b]Shadows[/b]
Enemies and the player have shadows now!

notes.title: v0.7.5-beta/demo update: Vacuum item, Balancing and more
notes.content:
[b]Vacuum[/b]
There's a vacuum item now that pulls all collectibles (food, xp, gold) on the whole map to you when you pick it up. There's a very small chance to drop it on every single enemy, a medium chance at chests and a guaranteed drop when defeating half time bosses.

[b]Renaming[/b]
Renamed Challenges to Mode, and the Endless Mode Stage to Desert.

[b]Balancing[/b]
Badlands and Desert provide more xp and gold now.

[b]Nicer Badlands[/b]
Made the look of Badlands a bit more appealing.

[b]Bigger Elites[/b]
Elite enemies (that have a golden outline) are bigger now.

P.S. Due to a screw up on my part i had to republish these patch notes a second time.

notes.title: v0.7.6-beta/demo update: Cats, new Shop and more!
notes.content:
[b]New shop[/b]
There's a new endgame shop available. You get to the new shop by pressing the new button "Extras" in the regular shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/7186eaf8c67a6705bf1704bdd5e9451db088865c.jpg[/img]

[b]Cats[/b]
There are cats to buy in the new shop! Wohooo!

[b]New item that drops[/b]
Enemies drop occasionally an item that kills all enemies on the screen.

notes.title: v0.7.4-beta/demo update: New challenge and more!
notes.content:
[b]New challenge[/b]
There's a new challenge to try out, the hallucination challenge! Try it out! You also get achievements for completing this challenge, like with every other challenge.

[b]Player damage and health[/b]
The screen flashes red now when the player gets hit. You can also see your health numbers on the gui while playing on the top left now.

[b]New upgrade selections when the ability bar is full[/b]
Instead of a choice between 40hp and 50gold, you now get a wide range of gold/hp and even stat increase choices when you have maxed out your ability bar.

[b]More gold in crypts[/b]
The crypts were a bit lackluster in terms of gold compared to the grasslands, now they provide more gold!

[b]Balancing[/b]
Lots of small balancing changes of enemies and player attacks.

notes.title: v0.7.3-beta/demo update: changes to icon backgrounds, speed up challenge & more
notes.content:
[b]Icon Backgrounds[/b]
Redesigned many icon backgrounds to make them prettier.

[b]Speed up challenge[/b]
Now includes much cooldown reduction.

[b]Class Balancing[/b]
Made many underpowered skills much stronger, especially for the dark mage, water mage and necro mage.

[b]And more[/b]
Lots of small changes.

notes.title: v0.7.2-beta/demo update: 2 new challenges and more!
notes.content:
[b]New challenge: Shorter Runs[/b]
In this challenge the level timer runs twice as fast! Enemies spawn twice as fast too!

[b]New challenge: Speed up[/b]
In this challenge both the hero and the enemies have a faster movement speed!

[b]New achievements[/b]
New (steam) achievements for beating the above two challenges

[b]Improvements to the costs in the shop/upgrade system[/b]
Costs now rise linearly by the number of previously purchased upgrades. The system before had rising costs depending on the total gold/xp amount spent, but that had the problem that there were different total costs depending which upgrades you purchase first and which later.

[b]Enemy balancing[/b]
Adjusted movement speed of some enemies so the enemies are a bit more different compared to each other. Also scaled down the damage of enemies in the crypts on higher difficulties, as they were able to nearly instantly kill the player.

notes.title: v0.7.0-Beta/Demo Update: New Reward System for Achievements!
notes.content:
[b]New Reward Unlock System[/b]
There is a new button in the hero selection menu that reads "Unlocks". When you click on it, you get to the new menu for the system:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/4d8442ab7cf41fb0331888267042022661882713.jpg[/img]

Each Achievement you unlock counts towards the progress of unlocking an unique reward!
I also added around 40 new (steam) achievements for this update! And more are coming!

Please note that (steam) achievements you earned before this update don't count in this new system, you have to unlock every achievement after this update again for the rewards.

[b]Other changes[/b]
- The attacks of the dark mage didn't feel powerful enough so many of his attacks are stronger now. 
- sound effect volume adjusted: many sound effects were too loud or not loud enough, fixed some of them now
- small bugfixes (not worth going into detail)
- minor enemy rebalancing (not worth going into detail)

notes.title: v0.6.4-beta/demo Update: Bugfix to Achievements and Balancing
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix to Achievements[/b]
Steam Achievements now unlock immediately (or at the end of the stage), instead of when closing the game.

[b]Balancing[/b]
The dark mage and the necromant feel a bit less powerful than the other three characters, so they got a little boost:
- Dark Mage's Burst of Energy got lower cooldown and travels farther forward
- Dark Mage's Demon Bull now spawns on top of enemies instead of randomly
- Necromant's basic ability (Ritual Dagger) now has three instead of two daggers, making it much more powerful. Upgrades also add more daggers and the daggers are more widely spread out, hitting in a bigger radius that way.
- Necromants' Summons have higher damage

[b]More targeted attacks[/b]
I plan to make more attacks actually hit enemies instead of randomly spawning somewhere, starting with the above mentioned demon bull ability and the tactical nuke of the firemage. Also improved the way the targeting works, instead of hitting a random enemy somewhere on the map, the attack hits a random enemy somewhere near the player (on the screen).

[b]Slower Wolves[/b]
Made Wolves slower in higher difficulties

[b]Minor UI Changes[/b]
Made some smaller adjustments in the UI, but nothing worth mentioning explicitly.

notes.title: v0.6.3-beta/demo Update: Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Added lots of explanations/ease of use to the game:

[b]Go Back by clicking/pressing esc[/b]
You can now go back in most menus by pressing esc or the right mouse button

[b]Bugfixes to skill description[/b]
Some skills didn't have a description at the latest upgrade level

[b]Difficulty Bonus Explanation[/b]
Added a note that says that the bonus xp and gold only applies after a run (not during a run)

[b]Crypts Stage Explanation[/b]
Made it easier to understand this stage by adding arrows on the ground and more detailed text popups during the game play (e.g. kill the boss within the time limit)

notes.title: v0.6.2-beta/demo Update: Small UI Change and Credits
notes.content:
[b]Small UI change[/b]
Buttons become light now instead of dark when hovering over them.

[b]Credits[/b]
Added some people to the credits. Everyone who gives me helpful feedback on the demo or the beta gets a mention in the credits now! If you wanna betatest the game hop on my discord and write me a message:
https://discord.gg/HYQwxzGS

notes.title: v0.6.1-beta/demo update: change to keyboard mappings and new music
notes.content:
[b]- Keyboard Mappings:[/b]
I had 90s style arrow key movement as default, but as most people prefer to use wasd controls, I made it as default that you can use both! The wasd movement is binded and can be changed to other keys in the options, while the arrow keys are always usable !
As a note: The new wasd mapping applies only to people who start the game for the first time as i don't want to override any other preferred method of people who already rebinded, so if you already started the game and want wasd you have to bind it in the options!

[b]- New Music[/b]
Each stage has different music now, the first one (in Grasslands) stays the same while the other stages have new music added! If you like the music, make sure to check out DavidKBD (look him up on your preferred search engine) who makes this and other music royalty free!

notes.title: v0.6.0-Beta/Demo Update: new feature is live - Challenges
notes.content:
I plan to provide challenges you can add to regular play for every map. So far i added the first one, the [b]Stay in the Circle Challenge[/b]. Select it in the Map Selection Screen:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158864/3e6d3fca833457a2d8a7cfa018706ef106c8cc33.jpg[/img]
